description: Authored examples for reviewer discussion; no games were generated, played or judged automatically.

cases.observation: From zero progress the car traverses all visible checkpoints in order, crosses the finish correctly, and the positive final time remains fixed for 3 seconds.

expected.reason: Requires an unbroken sequence, not a result screen alone.

cases.observation: The speedometer increases, but the car and world landmarks never move.

expected.reason: HUD numbers alone do not establish acceleration.

cases.observation: The car slows only when it hits a wall while the brake is held.

expected.reason: This observation does not isolate braking; test a straight or leave untested.

cases.observation: Reverse across the finish before checkpoint one and the game declares a completed lap.

expected.reason: Invalid crossing must not finish the race.

cases.observation: Car crosses the inner wall and retains skipped checkpoint/lap gains.

expected.reason: A rendered wall is not functional route protection.

cases.observation: Restart moves the car to the start but retains the prior checkpoint progress.
The platform login expired before the game could be opened.

expected.reason: Access failure is not evidence of a defective game.
